Offline finding and unknown tracker alerts
A lost or stolen phone can no longer be found while it is offline or switched off, and you will not be warned when an unknown tracker travels with you.
Location sent with emergency calls, and disaster alerts
When you call an emergency number the phone will no longer send its precise location to the responders, and flood or earthquake alerts from Google stop. This can cost time in an emergency.
The connection every app uses for notifications
WhatsApp, Gmail, banking codes and every other app stop receiving notifications unless they are open. Calls over the internet will not ring. Cut this only if you want a phone that never notifies.
Ads, trackers, scam sites and pop-ups blocked for every app
Names of ad, tracker, scam and gambling servers are refused before any app can reach them. No VPN, no certificate, nothing leaves the phone.
Filtering is not available on this build.
